cover.desc: Full color, cold institutional palette warming at one edge. A long corridor of numbered calibration booths seen straight down its length, doors on both sides, harsh overhead strip lights, a queue of students and adults standing along the wall in flat grey-blue — dozens of them, faces plain and hopeful, all facing away toward the far end. At the very front of the queue, small and warm-lit, two figures sit on the floor against the wall out of the line entirely, a pale-haired girl and a dark-haired boy sharing a paper bag of bread. Hard-edged shadows, bone and slate, one amber pool of light on the two of them. Colored lineart, enormous negative space.
